meta.name: prisma-client-api
meta.description: Prisma Client API reference covering model queries, filters, operators, and client methods. Use when writing database queries, using CRUD operations, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client. Triggers on "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction".

copy.tagline: 查询和操作数据库记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要经常查询和修改数据库中的数据。
copy.tagline_en: Look up database query patterns with Prisma
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write database queries and update records.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Prisma Client API 参考写数据库代码：增删改查、筛选排序、关联查询、事务与原始 SQL，并给出对应方法和参数用法。
howto.when: 当你用 Prisma Client 写数据库查询、做增删改查，或提到 “findMany”、“$transaction” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 Prisma 写一个带 where 筛选和排序的 findMany 查询
用 $transaction 把创建用户和创建文章合成一个事务
say.note: 会给出数组式事务写法

say.text: 写一个 create，创建用户时顺带创建关联的 posts
say.note: 会用嵌套 create 加 include

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes database code from the Prisma Client API reference: CRUD, filters, sorting, relations, transactions and raw SQL, with the matching methods and options.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write Prisma Client database queries, do CRUD operations, or mention "findMany", "$transaction" and similar keywords.

say_en.text: Write a Prisma findMany query with where filters and sorting
Use $transaction to create a user and a post together
Write a create that also creates related posts
